title: Horizon and Summit
author: Ulyana Fairweather
blurb: Jonah Vane, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
